12/17/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers and heifers 2.00-7.00 higher. Steer calves 4.00-10.00 lower except for calves under 400lbs 5.00 higher. Heifer calves 5.00 lower to 5.00 higher. Demand moderate to good. Weigh up conditions average to fleshy.
12/10/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 4.00-8.00 lower. Feeder heifers steady to 5.00 lower. Steer calves over 450lbs 2.00-7.00 lower, except for 550lbs-600lbs sharply higher. Steer calves under 450lbs 3.00-6.00 higher. Heifer calves over 450lbs 3.00-8.00 higher. Heifer calves under 450lbs 5.00 lower. Demand moderate to good. Quality plain to average.
12/03/2024: Compared to two weeks ago: Feeder steers and heifer 8.00-10.00 higher except 700-750lbs 15.00 higher. Steer and heifer calves fully 10.00 higher with instances of up to 25.00 higher. Quality average to attractive. Demand good to very good.
11/19/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers and heifers 2.00-4.00 higher with better quality. Steer and heifer calves 10.00-15.00 higher. Demand very good for all classes of cattle. Quality average. More rain moved through the panhandle Sunday and Monday. The wheat is looking very good. Cattle futures moved higher again today.
11/12/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 3.00-4.00 lower on limited numbers and lower quality. Feeder heifers steady. Steer and heifer calves that were weaned, fully steady. Steer and heifer calves unweaned 6.00-10.00 higher. Quality average to attractive on calves. Demand good to very good. Many areas in the panhandle received 2-4 inches of rain in the past week. All calves with the description fancy are unweaned cattle.
11/05/2024:
Compared to last week: Feeder steers over 750lbs 3.00-8.00 higher. Feeder steers under 750lbs steady. Steer calves 10.00-15.00 higher in a light test. Feeder heifers and heifer calves unevenly steady in a light test. Most of Oklahoma received beneficial rainfall this weekend helping to ease drought conditions across the state.

At the video auction had 1 draft of 140 heifers weighing 725lbs bring 236. Those heifers are included in the total receipts.
10/29/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers and heifers mostly steady except 6 and 8 weights steers sharply higher with improved quality. Steer and heifer calves lightly tested but a lower undertone was noted except 5 weight heifer sharply higher. Demand good. Quality average to very attractive. All calves under 600lbs denoted with the description fancy were unweaned and most came off one ranch. Much needed rain is finally in the forecast for this weekend and next week.
10/22/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers unevenly steady except 850-900lbs 6.00 higher and 950-1000lbs 6.00 lower. Feeder heifers unevenly steady. Steer and heifer calves over 400lbs unevenly steady. Steer and heifer calves under 400lbs lightly tested but a stronger undertone noted. Demand good. Quality average. Some of Northwestern Oklahoma received rain yesterday but 70% of Oklahoma is in at least moderate drought conditions. The end of October is nearing and much of Oklahoma is still in the 90s for high temperatures with no rain changes in the 10 day forecast.
10/15/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 3.00-4.00 higher. Steer calves 7.00-8.00 higher. Feeder heifers unevenly steady. Heifer calves 4.00-6.00 higher. Unweaned calves up to 20.00 higher. Demand good. Quality average.  With an increase in the number of calf buyers this week, the market on unweaned calves was extremely good.
10/08/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers steady to 4.00 lower except 900lbs 6.00 higher with excellent quality. Steer calves 3.00-7.00 lower. Feeder heifers unevenly steady. Heifer calves lightly tested but a lower undertone noted. Demand moderate. Quality average. Cattle health is starting to decline, lows are dipping into the 40s at night.
10/01/2024: Compared to last week:  Steer and heifer calves sold 2.00 to 7.00 higher.  Yearlings steers and heifers were mostly 2.00 to 5.00 higher.  Trade was active on good demand.
09/24/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 5.00-8.00 higher. Feeder heifers unevenly steady. Steer and heifer calves weaned sharply higher and unweaned calves sharply lower in a light test. Demand was good for weaned and feeder cattle. Unweaned calves with no shots were discounted heavily. Quality average to attractive.
09/17/2024: Compared to last week: Feeder steers under 800lbs., 1.00-5.00 lower and over 800lbs. 1.00-3.00 higher. Steer calves steady to 3.00 higher. Feeder heifers under 750lbs., steady to 5.00 higher and over 750lbs., 1.00 to 3.00 lower. Heifer calves were lightly tested. Unweaned heifer calves sharply higher. Demand was moderate to good. Quality average to attractive with many nice loads of feeder cattle.
09/10/2024: Compared to last week:  Feeder steers steady to 2.00 lower.  Steer calves 4.00-8.00 lower, except 500-600 lbs 2.00-4.00 higher.  Feeder heifers steady to 4.00 lower.  Heifer calves mostly steady.  Demand very good for feeder cattle with all buyers trying to get a piece of the pie.  Continued dry weather is limiting demand for calves.  Quality again average to attractive with several nice loads of feeder cattle available.
09/03/2024: Compared to last week:  Feeder steers and steer calves steady to 3.00 higher.  Feeder heifers 7.00-8.00 higher.  Heifer calves steady to 4.00 higher.  Demand very good for all classes.  Quality average to many attractive.
08/27/2024: No comparison of trends as this the first reported market for this sale.  Demand moderate to good for feeder cattle.  Moderate for calves.  Several loads of nice ranch raised feeder cattle available.
